Rat Cage Lids

A rat lid for every research need

7 purpose-built lids for use with Innorack® IVC Rat, Tall, and Tall XL. Each lid is designed to serve a specific housing application and compatible with Innocage® Rat or Rat XL bottoms
  • 100% PET
  • BPA-free
  • Recyclable

Dual Filter

RVX62

Dual filter IVC rat lid for use in Innorack. It uses two Reemay® filters covering exhaust and supply ports and a Uniblend static filter for enhanced ventilation.

Key Advantages:

  • For use with Innocage® rat bottoms.

Dual Filter

RVX5

Dual filter IVC. Autowatering. Uses two Reemay® filters and two ventilation grates. Immunocompromised. Standard IVC rodent housing; core facilities, quarantine, remote labs.

Key Advantages:

  • For use with Innocage® rat bottoms.

Single Filter

RVX6

IVC rat cage lid with large Reemay® filter for active side and Uniblend filter for passive side, external bottle cavity, and large filter area for use with wire bar in Innorack.

Key Advantages:

  • For use with an external water bottle and reusable wire bar.
  • For use with the Innorack IVC Rat.
  • For use with Innocage® rat bottoms.

Static Filter

RSX1

A static rat lid with external bottle cavity and large Unipro® filter area for use in emergency situations.

Key Advantages:

  • For use with external water bottle and reusable wire bar.
  • For use with Innocage® rat bottoms.

Single Filter

RVX7

Tall IVC rat lid with Reemay® and Uniblend filters and external bottle cavity for use with tall wire bar in the Innorack Tall IVC Rat.

Key Advantages:

  • Adds 2" of headroom.
  • Designed to be used with the Innorack Tall IVC Rat.
  • For use with Innocage® rat bottoms.

Dual Filter

RSX8

Tall IVC rat lid with dual Reemay® and Uniblend filters and external bottle cavity for use with tall wire bar in the Innorack Tall IVC Rat.

Key Advantages:

  • Adds 2" of headroom.
  • For use with the Innorack Tall IVC Rat.
  • For use with Innocage® rat bottoms.

Double Wide

RV7XL

Tall Rat XL lid with 2 large Uniblend and Reemay® filter media, allowing an additional 2" of headroom. Made of 100% PET and BPA-free plastic.

Key Advantages:

  • Designed for use with the Innorack Tall IVC Rat XL.
  • For use with Innocage® Rat XL bottom.
